title: Independent algorithmic review of RCCR-REFERENCE
acceptance_conditions: Every frozen requirement is represented; missing evidence is NOT_EVALUABLE/UNRESOLVED rather than dropped.
Coverage remains vector-valued; no scalar score/ranking/winner exists.
Diagnostic precedence applies protocol/exclusion and smaller explanations before INFORMATION_GAP.
METHOD_INFORMATION_ENTANGLED remains UNRESOLVED_GAP and is not coerced.
CapabilityNeedAssessment remains falsifiable/minimal/owner-bound and pre-evidentiary output cannot self-promote NEED_SUPPORTED or authority.
Decision traces reproduce every selected gap deterministically.
rollback: Forward-revert or supersede RCCRI-WP4 only; preserve WP0-WP3, governing plan/design bindings and all source/owner authority records. No force-push/history rewrite.
exact_work_after_pass: Record independent review decision; if no remaining semantic/source conflict or reserved authority delta, complete RCCRI-G4 delegated gate, squash-merge WP4, record merge receipt, and continue automatically to RCCRI-WP5.
